The reported 2.636 is slightly above the best known 2.635. The incumbent reports the same value, so this is most likely rounding of about 2.6359+. The harness's zero-tolerance validity check passed (no integrity flags).

Candidate -2.636 and incumbent -2.6360 are identical, and each has only one run, so there is no variance estimate. The difference is 0, so z = 0 if a noise estimate is used. The reject decision (no improvement) matches the numbers.
